title: Semi-annual model supply-gap simulator and contract-trigger runbook
creator: Aisha Verma
description: Create a reproducible simulator and decision runbook to quantify model supply gaps at semi-annual cadence and translate gap signals into contract/partner triggers for Dedicated and Private offerings.
background: Recent vendor churn events and regional CPU/GPU availability fluctuations have shown that downstream teams delay ramp decisions because they lack a unified signal-to-action playbook. This ticket scopes a combined simulator (supply vs demand scenarios) and a set of contract/operational triggers (procurement, fallback packaging, pre-warming reserved capacity) to reduce time-to-mitigation for enterprise customers in regulated verticals.
goals: Produce a semi-annual simulator that models supply shock scenarios (vendor outage, quantization incompatibility, regional capacity loss)
Define deterministic trigger thresholds that map supply signals to contractual or operational actions (e.g., procurement request, canary provisioning, customer outreach)
Deliver a 1-page runbook for Sales/AE and Customer Success that prescribes actions by impact tier for Dedicated/Private customers
Integrate two key dashboards: model-availability heatmap and contract-trigger history for post-mortem traceability
tasks: Design simulator input schema (model variants, regional capacity, quantization levels, latency floor, committed RPS)
Prototype Monte Carlo scenarios covering 18-month horizon and 10k synthetic customer workloads
Collaborate with Procurement to map cost-based thresholds for contract renegotiation
Define 3 impact tiers (low/medium/high) with explicit actions and SLA/notice windows
Build dashboard mockups with Observability team and specify required metrics and query definitions
Write runbook draft and circulate to Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Legal for feedback
Add simulator outputs to the Model Watchtower ingestion pipeline and schedule semi-annual runs
acceptance_criteria: Simulator produces repeatable scenario outputs (CSV + summary) for four canonical shocks
Trigger thresholds are documented and approved by Procurement and Legal
Runbook accepted by GTM stakeholders and published to Confluence with escalation matrix
Two dashboards created in Console (heatmap + trigger history) with data retention 90 days
Post-run retrospective template exists and is wired to PagerDuty incident links
signals_to_monitor: monthly model availability by region and variant
quantization compatibility mismatches reported by runtime onboarding
capacity utilization vs committed capacity for Dedicated pools
license/contract expiry windows for top-25 enterprise customers
third-party vendor outage bulletins and procurement SLA deviations
